name: Preview URL Resolver
purpose: The single project source of the string patterns for the two preview URL kinds (per-version-id URL, stable alias URL) and the mapping between an alias string and the version id it currently resolves to. Consulted by the Deploy Adapter's `uploadVersion` and `describeVersion` verbs and by every path that needs to reach the preview surface for review or verification.
responsibilities: Assemble the per-version-id URL for a given version id and the currently-configured Worker name and vendor subdomain (AC-12103-1, AC-12103-2).

Assemble the stable preview alias URL for a given alias string and the currently-configured Worker name and vendor subdomain; ensure the alias is quoted verbatim in the host segment (AC-12102-2, AC-12103-1).
Given an alias string, query the vendor for the version id currently behind the alias and return it (`resolveNewestOfMain` on the Deploy Adapter delegates here) (AC-12108-2).
Refuse an alias string that would collide with the production route's host segment; return `DEPLOY_URL_COLLAPSED` (AC-12105-2).
Guarantee the preview URL host segment can never equal the production URL host segment; the invariant is a property test at build time (AC-12105-3).
Expose a `probeUrl(kind, id-or-alias)` verb that returns the URL to hit for a given probe target (`versionId`, `alias`, or `production`), so the Served-surface Verifier need not know URL assembly.
internalStructure: Pure string-assembly module plus a thin query wrapper over the vendor's alias-lookup call. No cache: every alias query goes to the vendor because the alias is expected to change on every upload and the freshness cost of caching is not worth the complexity.

interfaces.name: workerIdentity
interfaces.description: Reads the Worker name from the wrangler manifest. Reads the vendor account's workers.dev subdomain from the Deploy Adapter's `resolveSubdomain()` verb (which honours a `WORKERS_DEV_SUBDOMAIN` env-var pin ahead of calling the vendor's `GET /accounts/<accountId>/workers/subdomain` REST endpoint, because no wrangler CLI verb returns the subdomain). Returns both as strings the URL-assembly functions consume.

interfaces.name: aliasQuery
interfaces.description: Queries the vendor for the version id currently behind an alias by reading `wrangler versions list --json` and filtering on `annotations['workers/alias']`, returning the item with the greatest `metadata.created_on`; there is no direct CLI verb (`wrangler versions view` accepts a version UUID only). Returns the id or a stable `DEPLOY_ALIAS_UNKNOWN` error when no version carries the alias annotation.

interfaces.name: probeUrl
interfaces.description: Named-verb URL accessor for downstream consumers. `probeUrl('versionId', 'v-123')` returns the per-version URL; `probeUrl('alias', 'main')` returns the alias URL; `probeUrl('production', null)` returns the production URL from the manifest.

dependencies.name: Wrangler Manifest
dependencies.description: Reads the Worker name and the production route stanza; the collapsed-URL invariant is checked against `productionUrl()`.

tradeoffs: The resolver treats the vendor's URL-string patterns as stable within the blueprint's major version. When the vendor changes the pattern (a new subdomain scheme, a new alias-in-host format), a blueprint major bump is what tracks the change; a project that pinned an older pattern by hand-editing the resolver loses the invariant guard. The trade is a small coupling to the vendor's public URL contract in exchange for one place to change when it moves.
